images.name: damage_right
images.prompt: 4K resolution. Make a MINIMAL pose edit of this EXACT supplied original knight game sprite. Preserve the original enclosed round helmet, small curved brown-gold horns, original gold face opening, broad shoulder/chest dark neutral steel armor, red scarf/cape, brown leather, kite shield with embossed GOLD FACE/CREST and sword/hilt. Same original grainy pixel-art shading, pixel density, outline, colors and proportions. No new helmet, skull face, cyan armor, photorealistic smoothing, blood, damage scratches or broken equipment. One single full body sprite, same 3:4 canvas and character scale. SOLID PURE WHITE background, no checkerboard, no ground shadow or effects. HIT REACTION: brief flinch/recoil, torso leaning backward, knees bent, sword and shield still held. Show front/three-quarter view with gold face visible; never a rear/back/cape-only view. The knight faces SCREEN RIGHT while recoiling toward screen left from a hit arriving on the right. Readable right-facing hit pose.
